caption:
The AI added a cache to stop duplicate API calls. One failed request, and the profile stays broken until the user reloads.

Look at the card. Caching the promise is a good idea: two components asking for the same user share one request. But the cache keeps whatever promise it got, including a rejected one. Every later getUser(id) returns that same failure, even after the network is back.

Fix: when the request fails, delete it from the cache and rethrow. The next call starts a fresh request.

Libraries like TanStack Query handle this for you, along with retries and expiry. Know what they're fixing before you hand it off.

Source: MDN, Promise.prototype.catch().
